1.  Gather or locate 4 snowballs in the game world.
2.  Open the crafting grid (usually a 2x2 or 3x3 inventory screen).
3.  Place the 4 snowballs into the crafting grid (they can be arranged in any pattern within the grid, such as filling the entire 2x2 space or placing them in a cross shape within a 3x3 grid).
4.  Take the resulting item from the output slot, which will be 1 snow block.
